GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 423 (14 Apr 46) ESS-IE
(SCAPIN-878)
APO 500
14 April 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : INPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
Subject : Raw Silk of Exportable Grades in Possession of Weavers and Manufacturers.
1. It is directed that all raw silk (amounting to approximately 5,000,000 pounds in unopened bales) in the possession of weavers and manufacturers as reported inventory required by Directive AG 423 (13 Dec. 45) ESS-IE, subject: “Inventory of Raw Silk, Semi, Griege, and Finished Goods”, be retested by the Japanese Government, conditioning House to determine its suitability for export.
2. Exportable raw silk is considered to be that of 42 denier and finer and export Grade E and higher.
3. The test reports on this silk shall be submitted to the Supreme Commander for the Allred Powers for determination of its suitability for export.
4. The retested raw silk which is found suitable for export is to packed in standard export bales.
5. It is directed that a report of the action taken be submitted to the Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers at the earliest practicable date and not later than 15 April 1946.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
B. M. FITCH
Brigadier General, AGD,
Adjutant General.
